overview.title: Contemporary art in a historic station
overview.p1: The Modern Art Museum of Tetouan occupies the city's old railway station, a handsome building that now hosts rotating exhibitions of contemporary Moroccan painting, sculpture and mixed media.
overview.p2: It is one of the best places in northern Morocco to see current artistic production alongside the city's strong craft tradition. The architecture of the station itself is part of the visit.
overview.p3: Combine easily with Place Hassan II, the Royal Palace exterior and a medina walk — all within a short distance.

q1.question: What can I see at the Modern Art Museum?
q1.answer: The museum features an impressive collection of contemporary Moroccan paintings, sculptures, and rotating exhibitions.

q2.question: Where is the museum located?
q2.answer: It is housed in Tetouan's historic former railway station, close to the central Ensanche district.

q3.question: How long does a visit take?
q3.answer: Plan for about 1 to 1.5 hours to explore the galleries at a relaxed pace.

q4.question: Is photography allowed?
q4.answer: Policies vary by exhibition; ask staff on arrival and avoid flash.

q5.question: Is it suitable for a short stop?
q5.answer: Yes. Even 45–60 minutes gives a good sense of the permanent and temporary shows.
